external_dependency.author: Christian Reiher
external_dependency.title: A Proof of the Theorem According to Which Every Prime Number Possesses Property B
external_dependency.result: Theorem 10.2: Every prime number has property B.
external_dependency.definition_used: Every length 2p-1 minimal zero-sum sequence over F_p^2 is simple, hence has a term repeated p-1 times and all remaining terms in one affine coset of its span.

conclusion: The three Q_i cannot simultaneously be globally labelled C_233^2 maximal atoms with a common kernel and the certified rank-two tail normal form.
not_claimed: the full p=233 problem is excluded
